mapper.select: SELECT a.account_no, a.member_id, m.name AS owner_name, a.bank_code, b.bank_name, a.balance, a.hold_amount, a.account_status, a.created_at FROM ACCOUNT a LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON a.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN BANK b ON a.bank_code = b.bank_code ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
SELECT password FROM MASTER_ADMIN WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND admin_status = 'ACTIVE'
